description:
Criteria: owner accepts brief requirements excluding map, emailed access/digest decisions, household assumptions, exact dates/timezone/digest configuration, retention and operating arrangements.
Artifact: deployable release candidate, verification evidence and runbook. Verification: record owner acceptance.
Prerequisites: allocation demonstration, problem/email demonstration, operational readiness and regression/accessibility. No dependency on map. No automatic production launch. Stage-1 limitation: ordinary ticket without automatically enforced approval gate.
title: Checkpoint: first-version acceptance
